question: Do the five named pending clinical FAPI cohorts contain authenticated EMC scans with same-patient FAPI/FDG or independently verified lesion observations capable of a new useful disease inference?
prior_art: R5 reviewed broad clinical FAPI studies, but no authentic EMC scan comparison survived identity; broad sarcoma uptake and paired-FDG differences are already published. R5 was shelved with explicit pending cohorts, not an absence claim. These five sources were identified but not evaluated then.
identity_rules: Inspect all published histologic categories/individual sarcoma rows and relevant conditions; no convenience EMC selection.
Keep author-labelled EMC distinct from molecular confirmation. Generic chondrosarcoma, sarcomaNOS or unspecified spindle/myxoid labels remain unresolved; do not relabel them EMC or silently exclude.
Record study dates, sites, trial IDs and explicit prior inclusion; Essen cohorts may overlap and repeated scans/lesions are not independent donors.
Clinical FAPI uptake cannot be inferred from FAP IHC, transcriptomics or non-EMC cohorts.

conditional_pilot.contrast: For verified identical lesion and donor, log2(FAPI SUVmax / FDG SUVmax); report all individual pairs and per-donor median rather than lesion-level independent tests.
conditional_pilot.primary_eligibility: Paired scan interval<=28days, no intervening tumor-directed therapy; record tracer/scanner/uptake times. Unknown chronology or incomparable metrics descriptive only.
conditional_pilot.secondary: FAPI-only lesions require independent pathological or stated longitudinal verification; uptake/scarring alone is not verified detection.
conditional_pilot.uncertainty: No sparse asymptotic tests, no population claim from isolated published illustrations; no pooling FAPI04/46/74 as calibrated equivalents.
conditional_pilot.conditions: Keep all positive/negative/treated scan conditions; no numeric extraction from an unlabeled plot without a demonstrable case crosswalk.
conditional_pilot.pre_analysis_state: No new source-specific EMC outcome values inspected.

alternative_explanations: Generic histology or wrong disease identity
Benign reactive uptake and verification bias
Original authors already established the useful result
decisive_stop: If no authenticated EMC measurement exists in the evaluated releases, stop numerical analysis and retain exact access/identity gaps. If a case exists but adds only a published isolated illustration, shelve absent a worthwhile independent contrast. No inventory or failed invented hypothesis qualifies as new disease knowledge.
followthrough: Investigate every material contradictory eligible EMC condition before advancement; all relevant public EMC evidence and independent challenge required. No manuscript before validity and value pass.
constraints: Only this R6 lane writable; 16MiB retained and >=10GiB free; quiet file/public API work. No UI/browser/headless/screenshots 06:00–10:00 America/New_York, DST aware, Sept12 exception expired. No paid/login/outreach/CAPTCHA/repeated unchanged403; no retries/takeover of platform-denied tissue/glycan/WGS/HLA-review. No commit/push/shared mutations.
